text: {"lessons":["I sold Stocks B, E, and C after gains; next time I’ll judge whether to hold or sell by future risk and prospects, not just by having a profit to lock in.","I’ll assess all five stocks and my cash as one portfolio rather than treating each stock as a separate account or letting its average cost define a win or a mistake.","Past price moves don’t predict future moves, so I’ll use a diversified plan and avoid reacting to every short-term change when deciding whether to trade."]}
